changes: Free provider contract, token access and quota diagnostics
Combined delivery capacity, recovery and contributor quality
Repository audit action fixes, compact UI, Research ownership and response swipe navigation
Explicit release qualification, exact-commit acceptance, performance comparison and payload inventory
limitations: Unified Reliability v2 is not complete; its remaining acceptance cases are not represented as passed.
